_comment: COUPLING tier-2. Verifies the two 'CANNOT' verdicts in knowledge(topic='precice'): 4C has no preCICE entry point, and FEBio as installed has no preCICE in the binary and no Python API. Runs each of the three probes the claim itself names — ldd for linked libraries, nm -D for the dynamic symbol table, strings -a for anything textual the build left behind — on both binaries as resolved by the live registry, plus a walk of each binary's own source checkout for any path matching *precice*. Eight probes, all required to be zero. Then checks both payloads still redirect to `couple`, because a refusal with no alternative is how an agent concludes the coupling is impossible. This is the fixture that notices if somebody builds a preCICE-enabled 4C: the knowledge would silently become wrong and every agent would keep being steered to the file handshake.
